description:
Read a structured paper-based analysis of key signals, methodology, evidence,
experimental conditions and verification points, with author-stated limitations
where available. Use it when these details help assess a candidate, compare findings,
or understand the context of a claim beyond the abstract.
Search results mark supported papers with scout_available=true.
Returns text including figure captions and descriptions. If needed, consult the
original paper through source_url for further verification.
Independent papers can be requested concurrently; up to five concurrent requests
are recommended per batch. For a timeout, wait as indicated and retry the same paper.

paper_id.description: Paper identifier from search results; scout_available indicates Scout availability.
paper_id.title: Paper Id
